summary: Iteration 44: real end-to-end test (no mocks) of the POS QRIS two-step flow. Owner baa logged in through the UI (consent, identifier, PIN 130994). On POS, the owner picked Dummy Rider via Absen; this rider has verified stock for 2026-10-23, so sales were possible. The test sold one SI AMERICANO on DESKTOP (1920x1080) and on MOBILE (390x844). ALL 8 REQUESTED CHECKS PASS: (1) PIN login works. (2) The floating cart opens pos-payment-sheet. (3) After selecting QRIS, pos-qris-preview is not rendered, pos-qris-front-button 'Tampilkan QRIS Rider' is visible, and checkout-button reads 'Tampilkan QRIS'. (4) The front button, and also checkout-button, open pos-qris-preview (z-index 90, above the sheet at z-70); elementFromPoint at the confirm button hits pos-qris-confirm-button and the QR image loads. Escape closes it without confirming. (5) pos-qris-confirm-button 'Lanjut ke tombol Bayar' closes the QR, keeps the sheet open, removes the front button and changes checkout to 'Bayar'. No POST was sent before Bayar. (6) Bayar sent exactly 1 POST /api/sales (cash_received 0, payment_method qris) and the sale-receipt modal appeared. The WhatsApp button is present but was not clicked. Closing the receipt leaves no overlay. (7) Mobile: bottom-nav sits at y=780-844. The floating cart (700-748), checkout, cart-clear, cart-total, confirm button and receipt buttons were all hit-tested as top-most and clickable, so there is no overlap. No horizontal overflow. NEW BACKEND BUG: a pure QRIS sale stores change = total, so the receipt shows 'Kembalian Rp 8.000'. QA sales S4-20261023-0004/0005 and the pytest sale were deleted, and the sale counter was reset to 3.

critical.issue: Pure QRIS sale returns and stores change = total, e.g. change 8000 on a Rp 8.000 QRIS sale. Cause, server.py ~1972-1976: cash_received = body.cash_received if cash_part else total; change = max(0, cash_received - cash_part). With cash_part=0 this gives change = total. The receipt modal, the WhatsApp text and stored data all show a bogus 'Kembalian'. The 3 pre-existing sales (S4-20261023-0001..0003) also have change=18000. Fix: change = max(0, body.cash_received - cash_part) if cash_part else 0, and ideally cash_received = 0 for non-cash. Then migrate or recompute the existing records.

integration_issues.issue: The receipt shows 'Kembalian Rp 8.000' for a QRIS sale. This comes from the backend change bug; the frontend renders it whenever receipt.change > 0.

issues: The qris-rider-ready hint still says 'Tekan tombol Bayar untuk menampilkan QRIS Rider, lalu konfirmasi...'. That is outdated: the buttons now say 'Tampilkan QRIS' and 'Lanjut ke tombol Bayar'. Update the copy to match the two-step flow.
There are two buttons with the same action, pos-qris-front-button and checkout-button ('Tampilkan QRIS'). This is acceptable but redundant.
Mobile 390px: cart-total 'Rp 8.000' wraps onto two lines ('Rp' / '8.000') and checkout 'Tampilkan QRIS' wraps too. Add whitespace-nowrap or a smaller font.
The dummy rider's QRIS image renders as a black rectangle. This is test data, not a code issue.

action_items: Fix POST /api/sales change calculation for non-cash (QRIS) sales so change=0, and fix existing records
Update qris-rider-ready hint copy to the new two-step wording
Optional: prevent cart-total and checkout label wrapping on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_sale: cash_received is defaulted to total for non-cash sales, which makes change wrong. Store 0 or None instead.
POS.jsx is 473 lines with very long single-line JSX (lines 315-316, 470). Consider extracting PaymentSheet and QrisPreviewDialog components.

The QRIS Dialog overlay (Radix, z-50) renders below the payment sheet (z-70). Only the content has z-[90]. Clicking outside the dialog lands on the sheet backdrop, which can also close the sheet. The cart is kept, so this is minor.

success_rate.backend: 0% of 1 test (fails only on the QRIS change assertion; create and idempotency pass)
